next.name: Aventura City Commission

schedule.note: Commission Inauguration Ceremony, Commission Chamber (swearing in of November 3 winners)
November regular meeting, moved from the first Tuesday because of the election; Commission Chamber

next.pattern: Regular meeting the first Tuesday of each month at 6:00 p.m., except August and December (no meetings), at the Aventura Government Center Commission Chambers, 19200 West Country Club Drive, or virtually when the agenda says so. A workshop follows about two weeks later, usually a Thursday at 9:00 a.m. in the 5th floor Executive Conference Room. The Local Planning Agency meets at 6:00 p.m. before regular meetings when there are zoning items.

levers.how: Speak at the Public Comments item near the end of each regular meeting (after Staff Reports) or at a public hearing item. To speak on a consent agenda item, tell the City Clerk before the meeting starts; you are recognized before the consent agenda is approved.
levers.rules: No time limit, sign-up form or speaker rule is printed on the agenda or the meetings page. The Commission Chambers are open to the public; meetings may be virtual when the agenda says so.
levers.deadline: Consent agenda items: notify the Clerk before the meeting begins

levers.how: No written comment procedure is posted. Email the City Clerk's office.
Call or visit the Government Center, weekdays 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., or use the staff directory for individual commissioners.
